objects.name: project_duplicate_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER project_duplicate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON work_items
WHEN NEW.level>1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.workScope'),'normal')='normal'
 AND json_extract(NEW.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NULL
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'project_duplicate') WHERE EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM work_items w WHERE w.id<>NEW.id AND w.level>1
 AND COALESCE(json_extract(w.value,'$.workScope'),'normal')='normal'
 AND json_extract(w.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NULL
 AND lower(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(json_extract(w.value,'$.title'),' ',''),char(12288),''),char(9),''),char(10),''),char(13),''))=lower(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.title'),' ',''),char(12288),''),char(9),''),char(10),''),char(13),''))
 AND json_extract(w.value,'$.lead.account')=json_extract(NEW.value,'$.lead.account')
 AND COALESCE(w.parent_id,'')=COALESCE(NEW.parent_id,''));
END

objects.name: project_duplicate_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER project_duplicate_update BEFORE UPDATE ON work_items
WHEN NEW.level>1 AND COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.workScope'),'normal')='normal'
 AND json_extract(NEW.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NULL
 AND NOT (json_extract(OLD.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_merge_operations op WHERE op.id=json_extract(OLD.value,'$.mergeOperationId') AND json_extract(op.value,'$.undoState')='restored' AND json_extract(op.value,'$.sourceId')=NEW.id))
 AND (OLD.level<=1 OR json_extract(OLD.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NOT NULL
 OR json_extract(OLD.value,'$.title')<>json_extract(NEW.value,'$.title')
 OR json_extract(OLD.value,'$.lead.account')<>json_extract(NEW.value,'$.lead.account')
 OR COALESCE(OLD.parent_id,'')<>COALESCE(NEW.parent_id,''))
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'project_duplicate') WHERE EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM work_items w WHERE w.id<>NEW.id AND w.level>1
 AND COALESCE(json_extract(w.value,'$.workScope'),'normal')='normal'
 AND json_extract(w.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NULL
 AND lower(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(json_extract(w.value,'$.title'),' ',''),char(12288),''),char(9),''),char(10),''),char(13),''))=lower(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.title'),' ',''),char(12288),''),char(9),''),char(10),''),char(13),''))
 AND json_extract(w.value,'$.lead.account')=json_extract(NEW.value,'$.lead.account')
 AND COALESCE(w.parent_id,'')=COALESCE(NEW.parent_id,''));
END

objects.name: project_merged_reference_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER project_merged_reference_insert BEFORE INSERT ON work_items
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'project_merged_reference') WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_aliases a WHERE a.old_id=NEW.parent_id OR a.old_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.relatedProjectIds'))) OR a.old_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.dependencyIds'))));
END

objects.name: project_merged_reference_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER project_merged_reference_update BEFORE UPDATE ON work_items
WHEN json_extract(NEW.value,'$.mergedInto') IS NULL
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'project_merged_reference') WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_aliases a WHERE a.old_id=NEW.parent_id OR a.old_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.relatedProjectIds'))) OR a.old_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.dependencyIds'))));
END

objects.name: summary_journal_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_journal_delete AFTER DELETE ON documents WHEN OLD.namespace='journal-sync' BEGIN INSERT INTO work_summary_state(user_id) VALUES(OLD.key) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET source_revision=source_revision+1; END

objects.name: summary_journal_insert

objects.name: summary_journal_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_journal_update AFTER UPDATE OF value ON documents WHEN NEW.namespace='journal-sync' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(OLD.value,'$.hash'),'')<>COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.hash'),'') OR COALESCE(json_extract(OLD.value,'$.revision'),0)<>COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.revision'),0) OR COALESCE(json_extract(OLD.value,'$.snapshot'),'')<>COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.snapshot'),'')) BEGIN INSERT INTO work_summary_state(user_id) VALUES(NEW.key) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET source_revision=source_revision+1; END

objects.name: summary_task_insert

objects.name: summary_task_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER summary_task_update AFTER UPDATE OF value ON documents WHEN NEW.namespace='shared-tasks' AND OLD.value<>NEW.value BEGIN INSERT INTO work_summary_state(user_id) SELECT user_id FROM employees WHERE account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(json_extract(OLD.value,'$.notionAccounts')) UNION SELECT value FROM json_each(json_extract(NEW.value,'$.notionAccounts'))) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET source_revision=source_revision+1; END
